name: Sa Pa to Cat Cat village and waterfall
why: Down from Sa Pa town through the Black Hmong village of Cat Cat, its indigo dyers and water-wheels, to a waterfall in the valley.
book: Village ticket at the top of the path. Walk back up or take a motorbike taxi.
dangers: Steep steps on the way back up.

points.name: Sa Pa
points.note: The hill town above the Muong Hoa valley.

points.name: Cat Cat
points.note: A Hmong village and waterfall in the valley.
